# anthropic_plugin_shares (Data Source)

Beta. Lists the shares the owner of a member-owned Claude Enterprise plugin has given (`GET /v1/organizations/plugins/{id}/shares`). Shares are read-only in the API: members give and withdraw them in claude.ai. Available to Claude Enterprise organizations only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_plugin_shares" "example" {
  plugin_id = "plugin_01EXAMPLE"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `plugin_id` (String) ID of a member-owned plugin (`plugin_...`).

### Optional

- `target_type` (String) Only shares with this kind of target: `organization`, `rbac_group` or `organization_member`.

### Read-Only

- `shares` (Attributes List) Shares, most recently granted first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--shares))

<a id="nestedatt--shares"></a>
### Nested Schema for `shares`

Read-Only:

- `granted_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the share was given.
- `rbac_group_id` (String) RBAC Group ID when `target_type` is `rbac_group`.
- `target_type` (String) `organization` (every member), `rbac_group` or `organization_member`.
- `user_id` (String) User ID when `target_type` is `organization_member`.
